Name: Lewis Grooveture (Dancing Lewis) (CP)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
Isn't it strange how quiet Lewis owns a fu**cking gold statue of himself? Let's turn this strange situation into something ridiculous absurd by making golden Lewis dance the [url=https://youtu.be/zWaymcVmJ-A?t=8]Macarena[/url].
[size=5][b]
Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the latest version of this mod from NexusMods or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/LewisGrooveture/releases]release page[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list][size=5][b]
Options & Compatibility[/b][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14269]Less Corrupt Lewis - No More Statue[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url]. Just install his mod beside this mod, and instead of Lewis, Marnie will dance.
[size=5][b]
Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Let Lewis dance (or Marnie)
[/list][b][size=5]
Contribute[/size][/b]
If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/LewisGrooveture/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16098?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url].
